KiwiSDR 官方公共接收站列表，点地图上的站点即可收听。: The official KiwiSDR public receiver list; click a site on the map to listen.
全球 WebSDR 站点汇总，按地区列出在线接收机。: A worldwide collection of WebSDR sites, listing online receivers by region.
公开接收机由站主自愿提供，请勿长时间占用单一频道，并遵守各站的使用规则。: Public receivers are offered voluntarily by their owners; do not occupy a single channel for long periods and follow each site's rules of use.
出于安全策略，多数接收站禁止被其它网页以 iframe 内嵌，因此这里以新标签打: For security policy reasons most receivers forbid being embedded in an iframe by other pages, so they open in a new tab rather than being embedded here.
可同时打开多个不同地区的接收机，对比同一条传播路径两端的信号强弱。: You can open receivers in several regions at once to compare signal strength at both ends of the same propagation path.
可自建的开源 Web SDR 软件，支持多用户与内置解码。: Self-hostable open-source Web SDR software supporting multiple users and built-in decoding.
在线接收机与收发站列表。: A list of online receivers and remote stations.
在线接收机页面自带实时频谱与瀑布图：打开后拖动频率，即可看到各信号的强度随时间变: Online receiver pages include a live spectrum and waterfall: once opened, drag the frequency to see how the strength of each signal varies over time.
太平洋沿岸的 HF 接收阵列，多副方向天线分集，适合听北美与太平洋信号。: An HF receive array on the Pacific coast with several directional antennas for diversity; good for hearing North American and Pacific signals.
最经典的公开 WebSDR 站点，覆盖长波到 10 米波段，界面与信号都很稳定。: The most classic public WebSDR site, covering long wave through the 10 m band, with a stable interface and signals.
社区维护的在线接收机目录，含地图与在线状态。: A community-maintained directory of online receivers, with a map and online status.
远程收听公共接收机，部分站点还可远程控制频率与模式。: Listen to public receivers remotely; some sites also allow remote control of frequency and mode.
选站先看「离发射地近不近」与「波段覆盖」：听本地中继和 FM 用 VHF 站，听: Choose a site first by "how close it is to the transmitter" and by "band coverage": use a VHF site to hear local repeaters and FM, and a high-latitude HF site for HF DX.
